_Comment_MutantHealth: MutantHealth: effective Controller health 1..10000; default 5000. Engine global HP ceiling remains 10000; incoming direct damage is scaled.
_Comment_SuicideChance: SuicideChance: probability (0..100 percent) for each eligible nearby player on control_attack_0; default 65.
_Comment_AuraDamagePerSecond: AuraDamagePerSecond: health removed per second inside the aggressive Controller aura (radius 70m). 0 disables damage, not effects. Default 2.
_Comment_PsiHitMinDamage: PsiHitMinDamage: minimum random health loss after a completed psi attack (0..10000). Default 10.
_Comment_PsiHitMaxDamage: PsiHitMaxDamage: maximum random health loss after a completed psi attack (0..10000). Default 20. Value must be >= minimum.
